claim: retrospective validation: parameters derived on the midday recording (origin 1163018600), evaluated on the PM recording (origin 1163030300), which was already inspected in aggregate during development; mechanism verification; no independent held-out claim

max_acceleration.method: median equivalent acceleration m3 of queue-leader departures (docs/MICRO_NGSIM_DEPARTURE_PROTOCOL_2026_11_19.md)

desired_speed_nb.method: population of per-vehicle p90 free speeds, direction 2 (docs/MICRO_NGSIM_DESIRED_SPEED_PROTOCOL_2026_11_19.md)

desired_speed_sb.method: same, direction 4; if invalid the road limit is kept

left_critical_gap.method: p15 of accepted gaps of permissive NB left turns at the 10th (docs/MICRO_NGSIM_LEFT_TURN_PROTOCOL_2026_11_19.md)

metrics: median stop-bar crossing error (model minus observed) with 95% bootstrap interval over vehicles
left turns: exclusion violations, accepted gaps, stop-bar crossing error
thresholds: none: absolute tolerances are not defined for any application; all results are reported, favourable or not
changes_from_v1: Time Warp variants removed from runtime invariance by the author (Time Warp is being improved and is too slow now); conservative with 2 JVMs remains. No parameter, scenario, metric or seed changed.
